title: Automatic IDOR and Data Leak in Parent-Student Resolver
impact: Unmatched parent accounts automatically link to the first student in the database, exposing PII, attendance, and bills of unrelated families.
fix_summary: Remove the first-student fallback query and return 404 when parent is unmatched.

title: Plaintext Password Storage in Database
impact: Reversible plaintext passwords stored in users.plain_password violate security standards and expose credentials if database is leaked.
fix_summary: Remove plain_password column from users table and return generated credentials ephemerally during creation only.

title: Runtime AttributeError in Background SPP Scheduler
impact: Daily 09:00 WIB cron task crashes on StatusSPP.LUNAS because the enum does not contain LUNAS, breaking all automated SPP push notifications.
fix_summary: Filter by StatusSPP.EXPIRED instead of StatusSPP.LUNAS.

title: Data Contract Mismatch on periode_bulan Format
impact: Payments created through receipt upload use '%B %Y' ('September 2026') while reports filter by '%Y-%m' ('2026-09'), rendering payments invisible in financial dashboards.
fix_summary: Standardize all periode_bulan writes to '%Y-%m' across the entire application.

title: Missing Ownership Authorization on Receipt Export Endpoint
impact: Any logged-in user can enumerate proof IDs at /{proof_id}/kwitansi and inspect private receipts of any student.
fix_summary: Add permission check ensuring current user is admin/owner or the parent linked to the student.

title: Undefined pwd_context in Password Verification Fallback
impact: If bcrypt raises an exception, Python crashes with NameError because pwd_context was never instantiated.
fix_summary: Define pwd_context CryptContext instance or handle fallback cleanly.

title: Logout Function Does Not Invalidate Server-Side Tokens
impact: Logging out only clears browser localStorage; access and refresh tokens are never added to Redis blacklist.
fix_summary: Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/logout with refresh token before clearing localStorage.

title: Tuple Return in FastAPI Health Check Returns HTTP 200 on Failure
impact: Returning a tuple in FastAPI defaults to HTTP 200 with a serialized JSON array, deceiving uptime monitors during DB outages.

title: Hardcoded VAPID Private Key in Source Code
impact: Default VAPID private key is committed in code, allowing anyone with repository access to spoof web push notifications.
fix_summary: Remove hardcoded default and require VAPID keys to be loaded strictly from environment.

title: Broken Deep Link in Web Push Notification Payload
impact: Parents clicking on push notifications are routed to non-existent /ortu/keuangan and bounced to home.

title: PostgreSQL Specific func.timezone Function Breaks SQLite Test Suites
impact: Hardware tap tests running against SQLite fail with OperationalError: no such function: timezone.
fix_summary: Use datetime range filter (start_of_day to end_of_day) instead of SQL engine timezone function.

title: Axios Interceptor Recursively Mutates Empty Strings to Null
impact: Non-nullable string database fields receive null instead of empty string when forms are submitted with blank optional inputs, triggering 422 errors.
fix_summary: Remove broad nullification or whitelist specific nullable foreign key fields only.

title: Receipt Verification Does Not Record Financial Transaction in Keuangan
impact: The Keuangan database table remains empty, leaving accounting records disconnected from billing approval.
fix_summary: Create a Keuangan entry inside approve_bukti_transfer.

title: Use of Deprecated datetime.utcnow()
impact: Produces deprecation warnings on Python 3.12+ and risks naive vs aware datetime mismatch errors.

title: Residual Test Scripts and Scratch Files in Backend
impact: Development scripts like cleanup_dummy.py and clean_db.py clutter the repository and risk accidental execution in production.
fix_summary: Remove or place under a gitignored maintenance folder.
